ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity white/cream pixels to 35% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity zones occupy the central and distal-inner regions of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous boundary along the entire trailing edge and extends inward from the median notch. Secondary low-intensity mapping includes coarse mottling at the pigment transition zones and solid black coverage of the fluke tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A deep, narrow U-shaped depression with a measured pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending roughly 12% into the fluke's vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern. Pixel-amplitude variations are most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes, featuring jagged peaks of 5-15 pixels. The inner trailing edge towards the notch exhibits lower-amplitude, more rounded peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a generally concave trajectory from the median notch to the tips, while the leading edge (partially visible) exhibits a strong convex curve, resulting in tapered, posteriorly-oriented tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (barnacle scars) are prominent on the black leading edge of the right tip and scattered along the black trailing edge margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark-pixel linear disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the high-intensity field of the right lobe, including one prominent near-vertical mark roughly parallel to the outer edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple barnacle colonization scars on the distal edges; vertical rake marks on the right lobe; irregular trailing edge notches likely representing minor past trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant yellowish-brown pixel distribution (diatom film) overlaying the white pigment on the inner sections of both lobes.
